name: Machine Learning for Computational Design
description: This course applies machine learning to mechanical design, covering data preprocessing, surrogate modeling, Bayesian and multi-objective optimization, and uncertainty quantification. Topics include ML-accelerated topology optimization, ML-assistedn digital twins, physics-informed models, generative design, and reverse engineering from CAD/FEA data. Hands-on projects use real mechanical datasets to develop and validate data-driven design workflows for structural, material, and component optimization.
